name: Martin Painter
headline: Former Senior Sales Director - Oracle NetSuite
about:
Global Cloud software pioneer with over 18 years in selling and working exclusively in Cloud software sales. Founded NetSuite's global operations outside the US and now currently responsible for Oracle NetSuite's International sales and operations in France, Germany, Spain, Italy, southern Europe & Israel.

Previously based in Australia, APAC and North America, extensive experience in global business markets.

Specialties: Business expansion, growth, cloud, sales, ERP, channel, marketing & product management.
